meta.name: Nidhi Chaudhary
meta.title: Senior MTS · Salesforce
meta.tagline: Machine Learning Engineer at Salesforce building secure ML platforms for data scientists. I dive deep into problems, architect for scale, and have led teams across three continents.

points: Develop a machine learning prototyping and debugging platform for Salesforce's data scientists and engineers to explore end-customer data in a secure and compliant manner.
Provide on-call support, resolve issues, research and design new features.
Implement, test, deploy and review functionalities and develop applications adhering to design patterns.
Develop a machine learning prototyping and debugging platform for Salesforce's data scientists and engineers to explore end-customer data in a secure and compliant manner.
Implement, test, deploy and review functionalities and develop applications adhering to design patterns.
Implemented unified approval process for Training and Experimentation to provide a platform for common approval flow for all projects.
Led a team of 4 to implement a backend framework for uploading data of multiple projects across partitions and serving it to mobile applications through REST APIs.

Designed a failsafe system for real-time reception and storage of time-series JSON and media data from mobile applications, relayed to third parties after analytics — 3× faster than the previous system.
Developed a standalone application to assist image processing-based IP verification, eliminating the manual process of difference visualization between Golden model and IP-generated images.

projects.title: Chinese Checkers AI Agent
projects.subtitle: Minimax with alpha-beta pruning to depth 4
projects.description: Built an AI agent to play and win Chinese Checkers in minimum moves by anticipating decision trees to depth 4 using minimax with alpha-beta pruning.

projects.title: FOL Inference System
projects.subtitle: Resolution-based first-order logic reasoning
projects.description: Developed a first-order logic inference engine for parsing and inferring FOL semantics using resolution — including parsing, processing, and unification.

projects.description: Full-stack responsive news platform with Guardian & NYT APIs, Bing autosuggest, bookmarking, social sharing, and persistent comments.

projects.title: News & Weather Android App
projects.subtitle: Location-aware with MP chart trends
projects.description: Android app with GPS-based weather, Guardian news, keyword trend charts, autosuggest search, and bookmarking.

projects.title: NewsApp — JS + Flask
projects.subtitle: DOM-driven carousels and word clouds
projects.description: Dynamic news site with Flask backend, DOM manipulation for carousels and word clouds, multi-dimension article search.

projects.title: Spoken Language Classifier
projects.subtitle: Neural network audio classification
projects.description: Built a neural network-based classifier to identify spoken languages from audio features as an undergraduate capstone project.
